name: Marketing Eye
summary: A practical B2B marketing partner for ambitious teams that need clear positioning and measurable growth.
positioning: Marketing Eye turns complex B2B expertise into useful stories, distinctive brands and focused growth programs.

services.name: Content strategy
services.description: Editorial systems grounded in customer questions.

services.name: Demand generation
services.description: Campaigns that connect content to pipeline.

services.name: Executive visibility
services.description: Thought leadership for senior B2B voices.

do: Lead with a useful point of view
sample_copy: Good marketing sounds like a useful conversation.

spokesperson.name: Morgan Hale
voice_notes: Write in the first person as Morgan, sparingly: lead with an insight, not with yourself.
Use "we" when crediting the team or describing Marketing Eye's work.
Measured and advisory: no hype words such as thrilled, excited to announce or game-changer.
Ground every point in client experience or the company context; never invent figures.
End with a question or a practical takeaway for B2B leaders, not a sales pitch.
